notes: 16 of 18 assertions pass in both configs: baseline already finds every root cause, groups shared causes, flags blast radius and leaves code untouched. Only discriminator so far is 'reply ends with a paste-ready prompt' (format).
Skill costs 2.2x wall time (+60s/case) and ~2x reply length (978-1274 vs 348-641 words). In an 80-min test where the user reads the reply, length is a real cost.

Skill adds depth baseline lacks: overflow edge cases in paging, TZ=-run proof across 3 zones, exact-expiry boundary, symptom-vs-cause trap (delete line vs ThenBy). Useful, but some is beyond the 8-min timebox the skill itself sets.
With-skill case 1 fix prompt bundles 3 causes + 3 new tests in one prompt, against the chain's one-step-per-prompt rule.
Assertions need harder discriminators next iteration: fixture with a misleading symptom site, or a check on length/timebox.
